assessments.support:
"samples with missing filenames and incomplete data are
excluded; and the remaining 880 samples across 17 international
sites are utilized, which include 418 ASD subjects and 478 TD subjects."
CPAC pipeline and Harvard-Oxford atlas (110 ROIs) both explicitly specified.
ASD/TD labels are taken from the ABIDE phenotype file; the specific diagnostic instrument/criteria per site are not described in this paper.

Stratified five-fold cross-validation with separate validation/test folds addresses single-split uncertainty, but no site covariate, harmonisation, or leave-site-out evaluation is reported despite the 17-site pooled cohort.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort, pipeline, atlas, and a properly separated train/validation/test five-fold cross-validation are all clearly reported, with code publicly released; main gaps are an unstated diagnostic-label source and no explicit site handling (covariate, harmonisation, or leave-site-out) despite the multi-site pooled cohort.

charting.feature_extraction_tools: Configurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes (CPAC), band-pass filtered, no global signal regression, via the Preprocessed Connectomes Project
charting.specific_features: Resting-state functional connectivity (Pearson correlation) between 110 ROIs; Harvard-Oxford atlas
charting.model_category: Deep learning — stacked autoencoder with explainability-guided ROI selection
charting.specific_algorithms: EAG-RS (explainability-guided ROI-selection framework: inter-regional relation learning via random seed-based network masking, connection-wise relevance scoring, ROI selection and classifier), compared against BrainNetCNN, BrainGNN, BrainNetTF, AE/SAE variants, t-test+SVM, LASSO+SVM, RFE+SVM, ASD-DiagNet and other published methods
charting.validation_methodology: Stratified five-fold cross-validation with separate validation and test folds (one fold each) and the remaining folds for training
charting.key_performance_results: EAG-RS: AUC 0.760±0.033, accuracy 73.71±2.83%, sensitivity 64.56±8.36%, specificity 80.74±8.28%, outperforming compared baselines
charting.dataset_openly_available: Yes — analysis code available at https://github.com/ku-milab/EAG-RS; data from the public ABIDE Preprocessed Connectomes Project release

domain_2_predictors_features.notes: CPAC pipeline and Harvard-Oxford atlas (110 ROIs) both explicitly reported.

domain_3_outcome_diagnosis.notes: Diagnosis taken from ABIDE phenotype file; instrument/criteria not elaborated in this paper.

domain_4_bias_transparency.notes: CL5 addressed via stratified CV with separate test/validation folds but training-only confinement of feature steps not explicitly stated; CL6 no site handling despite pooled multi-site cohort; CL7 code publicly released.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction study; ABIDE I, 880 subjects (418 ASD, 478 TD) across 17 sites after excluding incomplete/missing data
narrative_row.methods: CPAC-preprocessed resting-state functional connectivity (Harvard-Oxford atlas, 110 ROIs) used to learn non-linear high-order functional associations via an explainability-guided ROI-selection stacked-autoencoder framework (EAG-RS), evaluated with stratified five-fold cross-validation
narrative_row.outcomes: EAG-RS achieved AUC 0.760, accuracy 73.71%, sensitivity 64.56%, specificity 80.74%, outperforming comparative state-of-the-art and feature-selection methods; selected ROIs were linked to previously reported ASD-relevant brain regions and subtypes
narrative_row.key_limitations: No site covariate, harmonisation, or leave-site-out evaluation despite the pooled 17-site cohort; diagnostic instrument/criteria not elaborated; the paper itself notes it does not incorporate other neuroimaging modalities or clinical information
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Exact exclusion rule, pipeline, atlas and analysis code (GitHub) are all reported, supporting reconstructibility of the analysed cohort from the released ABIDE I data.
